reviews.title: Technical issue
reviews.text:
I experienced repeated and unintended charges while using this app and spent weeks trying to resolve the issue with support.

Nebula acknowledged the issue and approved refunds totaling $364.77 USD, but the process was extremely difficult and required extensive follow-up, transaction records, screenshots, and repeated explanations. Despite providing evidence of multiple charges and technical issues, I was left disputing remaining transactions and seeking further review.

My biggest concern is not just the charges themselves, but how the case was handled. I received repeated template responses, limited accountability for the technical issues that led to the charges, and had to escalate the matter multiple times.

I encourage users to carefully monitor their purchases and account activity and keep records of all transactions.

I hope Nebula improves both its billing systems and customer support processes so other customers do not have a similar experience.
reviews.reply:
Hello! Thank you for taking the time to detail your experience. 

We can imagine how exhausting and frustrating it must have been to deal with repeated charges, long follow-ups, and a support process that left you feeling unheard. Your feedback about the technical issues, the refund journey, and the communication you received is incredibly important and not something we take lightly.

We are deeply committed to improving all areas and making sure no user feels left alone or stuck in confusing processes. If you have anything else you’d like to share or if you still need support with remaining issues, please contact us directly at support-appstore@asknebula.com. reviews.reply:
Hi! Thank you for your comment. To determine your Zodiac sign, Modern Western Astrology looks at the 3 most important factors:
Your date of birth
Your place of birth
Your time of birth
The change of sign does not happen precisely at midnight. The exact time when the Sun switches signs also depends on your location.

For example, in 2019 the Sun entered Virgo on August 23rd at 6:02 AM in New York, but in Los Angeles, it happened at 03:02 AM. In 2020, since it was a leap year, everything shifted one day (after February) and the Sun changed from Leo to Virgo on the 22nd of August at 11:45 AM in New York and at 8:45 AM in Los Angeles.

The dates for the “beginning” of a new Zodiac sign are actually the dates when (most of the years) the Sun changes signs. Thus, by providing specific time and location you help us determine where Sun was positioned at the exact moment of your birth.
